analysis.title: PrimeView: Hedge Funds Reversed Course And Rebuilt Hyperscaler Exposure on Friday
key_insights: Hedge funds in the UBS PB book aggressively de-grossed AI exposure Monday through Thursday last week. The selling shifted from Semis (which dominated MTD activity) toward Hyperscalers, while Hardware and Memory saw modest long buying and short covering.
On Friday the pattern reversed. Hedge funds fully re-grossed the Hyperscaler exposure they had de-risked earlier in the week, funded by renewed de-grossing in Hardware and Memory.
One- or two-day aggressive de-grossing episodes followed immediately by an equally aggressive buy-the-dip are becoming increasingly common in UBS's flow picture.

Rebecca Cheong (UBS Equity Derivatives Strategy) attributes this to a shift in market capital composition. Long-duration capital (retail, retirement, foreign investors) has grown alongside short-duration capital (hedge funds, quants). The former anchors longer-term trends and the latter amplifies short-term volatility.
Per Cheong, corrections are becoming more frequent and sharper, but recoveries are also faster and more persistent. She is bullish in the medium term.
Hedge fund performance fell in Europe, the US and Japan last week, with Equity L/S and Quant down in all three regions.
China was a bright spot for Equity L/S managers, who are nearly back to flat after peak-to-trough losses of about 3.5% in October.
